cipher.summary: Closed RateLimitSeam's idle-key memory-growth gap with a full-map eviction sweep on every `checkAndConsume` call, backed by a contract test (500 idle keys don't poison a later reused key) and a direct unit test on the new `evictExpiredKeys` helper; consolidated with PR #163's already-fixed PR #160 review comments instead of duplicating them.
cipher.risks: The added per-call full-map sweep trades O(1) for O(active keys) per request; acceptable at expected traffic levels per the Consequences note above, revisit if profiling says otherwise.
